name: context-mon
description: Real-time prompt-cache efficiency, token and API cost meter with a Claude Code native look.

costThreshold.title: Cost alert step (USD)
costThreshold.description: Toast each time the session's net cost crosses another multiple of this amount.

missStreak.title: Cache-miss streak
missStreak.description: Alert after this many consecutive main-loop turns with a poor cache hit rate.

missBelowPct.title: Poor hit rate below (%)
missBelowPct.description: A turn counts as a cache miss when its hit rate is under this and it read a meaningful prompt.

minInputTokens.title: Min input tokens for miss check
minInputTokens.description: Turns with fewer total input tokens are never counted as misses.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime override (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: 0 follows the real lifetime the API granted, read from the session transcript (5m or 1h). Set a number only to force a value.

showBand.title: Show badge above prompt
showBand.description: Draw the inline turn badge above the prompt after every turn.

priceUrl.title: Price book URL
priceUrl.description: LiteLLM-format model price JSON, refreshed at most once a day.
